rules.top_2: top 2 score positions plus boundary ties
rules.top_3: top 3 score positions plus boundary ties
rules.top_half: ceil(action_count / 2) score positions plus boundary ties

secondary_population.definition: 25k-B anchors with root_action_count == 1; excluded from candidate claims

tie_audit.rule: all tied actions at a candidate boundary are retained; ties are never split by stable order
